p-hero.text: We offer facials, massage and skin treatments from R450 in a quiet Cape Town studio. Book your treatment on +27 00 000 0000.

p-treatments.text: We tailor every facial and massage to your skin, using gentle products and a calm, unhurried approach.

p-card-facial.text: Deep cleanse, exfoliation and hydration for balanced, glowing skin.

p-card-massage.text: Slow, firm massage to ease tension and support circulation.

p-card-peel.text: A light peel to refresh tone and smooth fine lines.

p-booking.text: We see clients by appointment in Stellenbosch and Somerset West. Choose your treatment and time, and we will confirm within one business day.

p-testimonials.text: Gentle treatments in a calm studio, right here in Cape Town.

quote-testimonial-1.text: My skin has never felt calmer. The facial was gentle and the results show.

quote-testimonial-2.text: A wonderful, unhurried massage. We left feeling properly relaxed.

p-about-page.text: We are a small beauty studio in Cape Town. We opened to give neighbours a calm place for facials, massage and skin care without the rush.

p-about-page-2.text: Every treatment is done by hand, with products chosen for sensitive skin. We take our time so you do too.

p-contact-page.text: Call us on +27 00 000 0000. We are in Cape Town and reply within one business day.
